name: Debashish Deb
title: Full-Stack Software Developer & Biotechnologist
tagline: Architecting modern digital solutions with scientific precision and software engineering craft.
about: I am a Full-Stack Software Developer with a unique foundation in Molecular Biotechnology (M.Sc. from University of Helsinki). I bridge analytical scientific rigor with modern engineering—building resilient web applications, intuitive interfaces, and scalable backend services.
aboutExtended:
I specialize in building and designing high-performance digital experiences. Proficient across JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, GoLang, React, Node.js, and Flutter-Dart, I develop end-to-end applications from intuitive, accessible frontend user interfaces to robust, concurrent backend architectures.

My scientific background—including peer-reviewed cancer research publications at the Institute for Molecular Medicine Finland (FIMM)—instills a deep analytical mindset, rigorous attention to detail, and a structured problem-solving approach in every line of code I craft.
status: Open to Full-Stack & Software Engineering Roles
